live.source: FUCompanion.api.experimental.sim.run, pace=batch, guests=false, ZP 0, FP 3, no feathers
live.note: All three logged 'conflict event: none' — sim.run does not read the scene's own conflictEvent flag, so these are storm-free.

liveWithStorm.note: The storm damages BOTH sides, so it barely moves the outcome — but it did KO Zarg in one run. Round count unchanged.

bias.direction: PESSIMISTIC — Mindscape consistently under-rates the party
bias.reason: This is the intended direction (spec Part 6): a fight Mindscape calls hard is genuinely hard. Do not 'fix' it by inflating party output.
knownCauses: summons not modelled — live fields 1-2 Fox fire phantasms on the party side that soak and deal damage
reaction layer not modelled — Prophetic Defender, damage reducers, and the conflict_start passives (Psychic Gifts, Beyond the Realms of Death, Heart of Darkness, Lucky Number) all fired live
Opportunities and Fabula Point invokes not modelled

howToRead: Treat a Mindscape verdict as roughly one round LONG and ~25-30 points LOW on party HP. A Mindscape result of '3 rounds at 53%' corresponds to a real fight of about 2 rounds at 80%.
